statement: Pinned Dolphin emulates two adjacent 11-byte IR calibration EEPROM blocks at offsets 0x0000 and 0x000B, using four camera calibration points with packed upper coordinate bits and one trailing checksum byte in each. It populates both blocks from the same synthetic template. This layout is an emulator behavior claim, not captured retail calibration.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: WiimoteEmu.h 257-265; WiimoteEmu.cpp 110-135; no raw data or emulator default values reproduced.
